items.difficulty_reason: For an affine formal algebraic space X over S, the lemma states the equivalence of two conditions: that X be the colimit of a sequence X_1 -> X_2 -> ... of thickenings of affine schemes, and that X admit a presentation X = colim X_lambda with Lambda countable (statement lines 2422-2433). The proof records the point that makes the two conditions the same: a countable directed set has a cofinal subset isomorphic to (N, >=), so any countable presentation can be reindexed as a sequence and conversely (proof lines 2435-2438). The level is H2: the equivalence is short, but the passage between the two indexings is exactly what has to be observed, and it is stated with the cofinality reason.
